description: A sync service with several planted issues: a Combine retain cycle, a data race on a shared mutable cache from an unstructured Task on an unisolated class, an out-of-range crash on empty input, and a silently swallowed network error. The force-unwrap must NOT be flagged (deferred to SwiftLint). Validated live on CrossedPaths PR #98.

should_flag.hint: The sink closure captures `self` strongly and the AnyCancellable is stored on self.cancellables -> reference cycle; the service never deallocates. Fix: [weak self].
cachedPlaces is mutated from inside an unstructured `Task {}` on a plain (unisolated) class while placesInCommon(with:) can read it concurrently -> data race. Fix: make it an actor or @MainActor.
In parse, `parts[0..<(parts.count - 1)]` underflows to a negative upper bound and traps at runtime when parts is empty (empty/separator-only response).
`try? Data(contentsOf:)` silently discards network errors; a failure becomes an empty result and silently clears the cache, indistinguishable from a real empty response.

should_not_flag.hint: The force-unwrap `URL(string:)!` must NOT be flagged — force_unwrapping is deferred to SwiftLint per the iOS rules.
No SwiftLint-style nits (formatting, naming, line length, modifier order).
